root_cause: The only failure is the yosys synthesis gate timing out at 150s. Bisection locates the culprit in rtl/rename_unit.sv: the checkpoint-save loop in the allocation branch writes a 2D unpacked array with a variable row index (ckpt_map_nxt[alloc_slot][i] = spec_map_nxt[i]), which makes the yosys frontend/proc expansion explode. The fix is a behavior-preserving rewrite to row-decoded constant-index writes, plus an audit of any other variable-index writes into unpacked 2D arrays in rename_unit.sv; prior patches did not fully implement this row decode.
repair_constraints: Do not rename any module, file, or port; keep the rv32i5 and rename_unit interfaces exactly as in the plan.
Preserve all TB-visible behavior and cycle-level semantics: checkpoint save/restore, free-list/bitmap allocation, rename mappings, and flush/flush_rob_index handling must remain unchanged.
Rewrite every variable-row-index write into an unpacked 2D array in rename_unit.sv as row-decoded constant-index writes; audit ckpt_map_nxt and any other unpacked 2D arrays.
Do not touch the already-correct FIFO-to-bitmap free-list refactor.
Limit the patch to rename_unit.sv unless the audit proves another file contains the same variable-index 2D-array write; yosys must complete within the synthesis gate.
